Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and there are rumours that the iPhone Pro models will adopt a brand-new bold design. The latest leak has revealed the larger screen sizes that are reportedly going to be used.

iPhone Pro next year will come with larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch screens

For the 10th anniversary of the iPhone in 2017, Apple prepared a very special model: the iPhone X.

There are rumours that the company is preparing a similar unique product for next year's 20th anniversary.

According to reports, next year's iPhone Pro models will feature a borderless, quad-curved screen that extends to the edges of the body.

The Dynamic Island cutout may be shrunk or even removed, achieving a seamless all-glass appearance.

According to the latest post by tipster Digital Chat Station, Apple is also preparing new screen sizes. He said the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4 inches, up from the current 6.3 inches
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7 inches, up from the current 6.9 inches

He added that the actual body size of both devices will increase, but the aspect ratio of the current models will be maintained. So it sounds like the larger screens are not only due to reduced bezels.

The last time Apple increased the Pro model screen sizes was in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1 inches to 6.3 inches, and the Pro Max went from 6.7 inches to 6.9 inches.

Although the size adjustment next year sounds smaller in magnitude, due to the quad-curved design, the overall feel should be more distinctive.

What do you think of the rumoured design for next year's iPhone Pro models? Feel free to share in the comments section.
